title: Would You Wrather?
description: Siblings Cooper and Cami Wrather livestream from their home and crowd-solve problems with the help of their little brother, Ollie, and their best friend, Fred.
quote: Ok Wrather Heads! Today we’re debating an age old question.
altHero: Cooper and Cami, tween brother and sister
alt2: Cooper and Cami with a question on screen: “Would you rather eat mix of leftovers or take a bath in it?”
alt3: their little brother, Ollie, in the sink filled with the leftovers
